svg.text: Melodee · patterns, sections and songs

As built (firmware: ui_song.c, ui_patterns.c). Mockups at device scale ×1.5; the device draws them in its own type and sizes (manual: song.png, song_section.png). SELECT sets a length; REC launches live.
How to read these screens
P2
Pattern: one track’s loop.
Each track has its own P1–P8.
B
4 bars
Section: a pattern (or rest) for every track,
and a length. Same letter = same section.
Song: sections in order, left to right.
+ adds a section from what’s playing.
SONG
Columns in order: A B A C. Each shows the section’s
letter, length and its patterns. Both As are the same
section, so editing A changes both. No repeats, no
blocks across columns: every track restarts at a column.
SONG · add a section
Cursor on +: OCT+ saves what every track is playing
as a section. If those patterns already match a
section, that section is placed again (A, not a copy).
Removing a column removes only that place.
SECTION B · AUTO length

g.text: K1–K4 pattern · SELECT length · PLAY loops it

svg.text: Opened with OCT+ on a column. Same rows as PATTERNS:
K1–K4 choose each track’s pattern, or REST.
AUTO length follows the longest pattern (T2 P2, 4 bars);
shorter ones loop to fill it: T1 ×4, T3 ×2.
SECTION B · length set by hand

g.text: K1–K4 pattern · SELECT length · PLAY loops it

svg.text: SELECT set it to 3 bars: fixed now. T2’s 4 bars are cut
after 3 bars (red mark); T3’s second loop is cut short.
PLAY loops just this section so you can hear it.
Sounds and FX punches for B are also set here.
SONG · live launch (REC)

g.text: First launch: next bar. Then: at the end of A.

svg.text: REC on a column queues its section for every track
together. Stopped: at once. Patterns playing: the next
bar, then the end of the one launched. The header says
what is next. Patterns and rests only.
PATTERNS · live change over A

g.text: SONG → OCT+ on + saves this as section D.

svg.text: A is playing and track 2 is switched to P3 as usual.
That is a live change, not an edit of A: the header
says A CHANGED. To keep it, add it on SONG as a
new section.
Behaviour
Pattern
One track’s loop, P1–P8. Editing its notes changes every section that uses it.
Section
One definition, used any number of times. Up to 26 (A–Z). Holds a pattern or REST per track, a length, sounds and FX punches.
Length
Bars and beats; SELECT on the section page, a beat a detent. AUTO follows the longest pattern until set. Shorter loop; longer are cut.
Song
Up to 64 columns, played left to right. Every track restarts at each column; nothing carries across.
Add
OCT+ on + adds what is playing. Matching patterns place the existing section again.
Remove
Removes that column only. A section disappears when its last column goes.
Live
REC on SONG launches a section: first on the next bar, then at the end of the playing one. PATTERNS changes are live only.
Removed
The jam and Take jam, repeats, blocks stretched across sections, and timing set by track 1.
Old songs
Converted on load: identical rows become one section. Songs that used stretched blocks may sound different; the load says so.
